title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: Version 1.4.0 adds the Week-7.1 rarefied hypersonic-cylinder operator-learning lab and lecture, checksummed 20-case DSMC teaching data, full-resolution cylinder visualization, and an ordered gallery with separate entries for every course week. It also retains improved nozzle boundary/registration diagnostics and controlled micro-step architecture comparison tools. The release preserves transparent baselines, negative results, source provenance, and explicit validity limits.
